prompt: An old regional map of a wild northern land filling the whole frame: a rugged coastline along the far left edge with the sea beyond it, a misty grey forest in the left middle, a small walled road town in the centre with roads spreading out from it, a range of snowy mountains across the top, a dark reedy marsh at the bottom, crumbling ancient ruins on low hills at the right.

A crossroads on an old muddy trade road across rolling moorland under a heavy grey sky: the road clearly splits into two roads that lead away in different directions, a weathered wooden signpost with plain blank arms stands at the fork, a broken milestone, distant hills, a few crows.

A hidden gambling den and thieves' tavern in a vaulted brick cellar under a town: round wooden tables with scattered dice, playing cards and small piles of coins, a short bar counter with bottles and kegs, heavy red curtains, smoky air lit by hanging lanterns and candles, a narrow stone stair leading up to a hidden door.

The common room of a warm old fantasy inn and tavern at night: long wooden tables and benches with pewter tankards and candles, a bar counter with casks and shelves of bottles, a great stone hearth with a crackling fire, heavy oak beams with hanging iron lanterns, a wooden staircase up to the guest rooms, a hunting trophy and old shields on the walls.

An empty suit of ancient plate armour standing on its own in a dim castle hall, a faint blue light glowing inside the dark helmet; one rusted greatsword stands point-down on the stone floor in front of it, and both steel gauntlets are wrapped firmly around the sword's long hilt just above the crossguard.

A rough adult bandit with a scarred face and a hooded cloak, standing on a muddy road; his right hand grips the hilt of one short sword with the blade pointing forward, his left hand is empty and open at his side.

A towering undead knight with exactly two arms, made of bleached old bones inside rusted ancient plate armour with a tattered dark-red surcoat, cold green light in the eye sockets of its helm; one long notched greatsword stands point-down on the floor in front of it and both bony gauntleted hands grip its hilt together. A burial chamber with green flames behind.

A wiry swamp goblin with exactly two arms, green-grey skin, long ears and a crooked grin, wearing scraps of leather, standing in shallow muddy water; it holds one rusty spear diagonally across its body, its right hand on the lower shaft and its left hand on the upper shaft.

A stern veteran guard captain in polished half-plate with a dark blue cloak, grey-streaked short beard, a brass whistle on a chain at his chest, standing in a manor hall lit by wall sconces; his right hand grips the hilt of one drawn longsword held low, and his left hand rests on his belt.

A monstrous harpy perched on a bare rocky sea cliff in the cold grey light of a storm: a bird creature covered in dark ragged feathers from neck to talons, a gaunt grey face with wild hair and a hooked nose, huge tattered wings spread wide, clawed bird feet gripping the rock, storm clouds and a grey sea behind. Only rock, sea and sky around it.

One giant sea serpent with a single head and a single long continuous body: its head on a long scaled neck rises high out of stormy waves, and behind it the same one body arches out of the water in a few loops that clearly connect to the neck. A wrecked ship nearby, lightning in the dark sky.

A huge hunched mountain troll with grey stony skin and exactly two long arms, standing on a snowy mountain pass; its right hand holds one tree-trunk club resting on its shoulder, its left hand hangs empty at its side.

A sinister old swamp witch in a dark hut, green fire under a bubbling cauldron, bones and herbs hanging from the rafters; her right hand holds one crooked wooden staff, and her left hand is hidden inside the long sleeve of her ragged robe.

An adult female mage in her twenties with silver-blond hair and calm, natural grey eyes, wearing dark violet robes, holding one old spellbook in her left hand and one slender staff in her right hand, a soft violet glow only at the tip of the staff.

An adult male thief in his twenties with messy hair and a relaxed, friendly, good-natured half-smile and bright honest eyes, likeable and roguish rather than scheming, wearing a dark hooded leather jacket with many pockets, one gold coin held between the fingers of his right hand, one dagger sheathed at his belt.

An adult female warrior in her thirties with braided red hair and a fierce expression, wearing steel plate armour over chainmail; her right hand grips the hilt of one longsword, and one kite shield is strapped on her left forearm, so the sword and the shield are in opposite hands.

An adult male warrior in his thirties with a short beard and a determined expression, wearing battered steel plate armour over chainmail; his right hand grips the hilt of one longsword, and one round shield is strapped on his left forearm, so the sword and the shield are in opposite hands.

A tough adult woman hunter in her forties with short dark hair and a scar on her cheek, wearing a fur-lined leather coat, standing in a misty forest; her left hand holds one plain wooden longbow upright at her side by the grip in the middle of the bow, the bow a single smooth curved stave with one straight string, her right hand resting on the quiver strap across her chest.
